{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Heavy wool trench coat in charcoal grey (#3e4247) with a straight cut and knee-length hem to protect against snow and wind.
Merino wool turtleneck sweater in navy blue (#1b2a45) featuring a relaxed fit and long sleeves for warmth during the brisk walk.
Dark wash denim trousers in black (#0f0f0f) with a tapered leg and mid-rise waist for comfort while commuting on icy sidewalks.
Ankle boots in polished brown leather (#8b6d53) with a low block heel and waterproof rubber sole to handle salted roads.
Leather gloves in dark tan (#4e3c30) paired with a structured leather belt in matching brown to keep accessories practical yet refined.
This outfit balances the need for serious work-appropriate neatness with robust protection against frost, snow, and slippery conditions. The heavy wool layers ensure she stays warm during her twenty-minute walk without sacrificing the clean lines required for a professional environment. Dark, neutral tones like charcoal and navy create a cohesive look that appears polished despite the harsh weather, while the practical footwear guarantees stability on salted streets."}
